verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Gmail API REST reference that documents endpoints and methods such as users.messages.send, drafts and watch. Nothing in the pack shows that this reference is interactive or offers runnable examples (for example a try-it console or executable samples), and the probes found no OpenAPI spec at the checked paths. A static reference is adjacent to this story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
